questions.question: --------- is a process where the precipitate is re-dissolved and precipitated out of a cleaner environment.

explanations.a: Dissociation is not the correct process here.
explanations.b: Digestion is related but not the process of re-dissolution and re-precipitation.
explanations.d: Correct: Crystallization involves re-dissolving and precipitating in a cleaner environment.

questions.question: Digestion can help reduce the amount of-------------

explanations.a: Digestion does not reduce precipitation itself.
explanations.b: Incorrect: Post-precipitation is not significantly affected by digestion.
explanations.c: Correct: Digestion reduces co-precipitation by allowing impurities to separate.
explanations.d: Nucleation is the initial step and not reduced by digestion.

questions.question: The mass of substance is measured as a function of temperature in-----------

explanations.a: Not related to temperature-based mass measurement.
explanations.d: Correct: Thermogravimetry measures mass changes as temperature varies.

questions.question: -----------is the incorporation of trace element into mineral structure during solid solution formation and recrystallization of minerals.

explanations.a: Occurs after main precipitation and not during recrystallization.
explanations.b: Adsorption involves surface interaction, not structural incorporation.
explanations.c: Nucleation is the initiation step, unrelated to trace incorporation.
explanations.d: Correct: Co-precipitation includes incorporation of impurities into crystal structure.

questions.question: ------------is a term used to describe the effect on a solution of two dissolved solutes that contain the same ion or ions.

explanations.a: Phase effect refers to phase boundaries, not ion concentration.
explanations.c: Correct: Common ion effect impacts solubility of compounds with shared ions.
explanations.d: Salt effect involves ionic strength, not necessarily common ions.

questions.question: Ion product---------- Ksp, thus a precipitate will form

explanations.b: Correct: Precipitation occurs when ion product exceeds Ksp.
explanations.c: No precipitation occurs if ion product is less than Ksp.
explanations.d: Zero means no ions present, so no precipitation.
